 HCPC Analysis for PB Cluster 3
 

```{r}
f.PCAdata.PB.3 <- filter(f.PCAdata.PB, cluster == "Cluster 3") # Extract the data just for Females in PB Cluster 3
row.names(f.PCAdata.PB.3) <- f.PCAdata.PB.3$TOPPID

# Need to get rid of columns with zeroes
f.PCAdata.PB.3 <- f.PCAdata.PB.3 %>% select(where(~ any(. != 0)))

#First exploratory PCA with all data, including Isotopes
PCA.f.1.PB.3 <- prcomp(f.PCAdata.PB.3[c(5:24)], center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
summary(PCA.f.1.PB.3)
get_eigenvalue(PCA.f.1.PB.3)

# Plot the PCs to look at variance explained
pdf("../figures/PCAVariance_PB3.pdf")
screeplot(PCA.f.1.PB.3, type = "l", npcs = 10, main = "Screeplot of the first 10 PCs")
abline(h = 1, col="red", lty=5)
legend("topright", legend=c("Eigenvalue = 1"),
       col=c("red"), lty=5, cex=0.6)
dev.off()

screeplot(PCA.f.1.PB.3, type = "l", npcs = 10, main = "Screeplot of the first 10 PCs")
abline(h = 1, col="red", lty=5)
legend("topright", legend=c("Eigenvalue = 1"),
       col=c("red"), lty=5, cex=0.6)

# Cumulative proportion
cumpro <- cumsum(PCA.f.1.PB.3$sdev^2 / sum(PCA.f.1.PB.3$sdev^2))
pdf("../figures/PCACumulativeVariance_PB3.pdf")

plot(cumpro[0:10], xlab = "PC #", ylab = "Amount of explained variance", main = "Cumulative variance plot")
abline(v = 4, col="blue", lty=5)
abline(h = 0.96509 , col="blue", lty=5) # Cumulative variance explained by the 10 PCs
legend("topleft", legend=c("Cut-off @ PC 4"),
       col=c("blue"), lty=5, cex=0.6)
dev.off()

plot(cumpro[0:10], xlab = "PC #", ylab = "Amount of explained variance", main = "Cumulative variance plot")
abline(v = 4, col="blue", lty=5)
abline(h = 0.96509 , col="blue", lty=5) # Cumulative variance explained by the 10 PCs
legend("topleft", legend=c("Cut-off @ PC 4"),
       col=c("blue"), lty=5, cex=0.6)

# Check the loadings and scores
pdf("../figures/PCAScores_PB3.pdf")
autoplot(PCA.f.1.PB.3, data = f.PCAdata.PB.3, colour = 'ProcedureYear', loadings = TRUE, 
         loadings.colour = 'blue',loadings.label = TRUE, loadings.label.size = 3, main = "Year")
dev.off()

autoplot(PCA.f.1.PB.3, data = f.PCAdata.PB.3, colour = 'ProcedureYear', loadings = TRUE, 
         loadings.colour = 'blue',loadings.label = TRUE, loadings.label.size = 3, main = "Year")

# Fancy plot with ellipses
pdf()
f <- fviz_pca_ind(PCA.f.1.PB.3, geom.ind = "point", pointshape = 21, 
             pointsize = 2, 
             fill.ind = f.PCAdata.PB.3$ProcedureYear, 
             col.ind = "black", 
             palette = "simpsons", 
             addEllipses = TRUE,
             label = "var",
             col.var = "black",
             repel = TRUE,
             legend.title = "Year") +
  ggtitle("2D PCA-plot from trip variables") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

print(f)

ggsave(filename = "../figures/PCAGroups_PB3.pdf",
       plot = f,
       device = cairo_pdf)

# HCPC with 4 PCs
fPCAhc.PB.3 <- scale(f.PCAdata.PB.3[c(5:24)])
res.pca.f.1.PB.3 <- PCA(fPCAhc.PB.3, ncp = 4, graph = FALSE)

# Extract the loadings
loadings.pca.f.1.PB.3 <- sweep(res.pca.f.1.PB.3$var$coord,2,sqrt(res.pca.f.1.PB.3$eig[1:ncol(res.pca.f.1.PB.3$var$coord),1]),FUN="/")
 
# Rotate the loadings 
loadings.pca.f.1.PB.3 <- varimax(loadings.pca.f.1.PB.3)$loadings

# Replace the values using the rotated
res.pca.f.1.PB.3$var$coord <- loadings.pca.f.1.PB.3
pca.var <- get_pca(res.pca.f.1.PB.3, element = c("var", "ind"))

coord <- pca.var[["coord"]]
contrib <- pca.var[["contrib"]]

write.csv(coord,'../results/PCAcoord_PBC3.csv')
write.csv(contrib,'../results/PCAcontrib_PBC3.csv')


# Compute hierarchical clustering on principal components
res.hcpc.1.PB.3 <- HCPC(res.pca.f.1.PB.3, 
                        kk = Inf, 
                        min = 3, 
                        max  = 10, 
                        metric = "euclidean", 
                        method = "ward", 
                        consol = TRUE,
                        graph = FALSE)

plot(res.hcpc.1.PB.3) # 5 clusters

# Check that k is right
ind.PCAPB.3 <- get_pca_ind(res.pca.f.1.PB.3)
ind.PCAPB.3 <- data.frame(ind.PCAPB.3$coord[,1:4])
ind.PCAPB.3 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(ind.PCAPB.3, "AnimalID")
col2keep <- c("Dim.1","Dim.2","Dim.3","Dim.4")
ind.PCAPB.3 <- ind.PCAPB.3[,col2keep]

res.nbclust <- NbClust(ind.PCAPB.3, distance = "euclidean",
                       min.nc = 2, max.nc = 5, 
                       method = "ward.D", index ="sdbw")

# kl: 5; ch: 5; hartigan: 5; cindex: 2; db: 5; silhouette: 5; duda: 2;
# pseudot2: 4; beale: 2; ratkowsky: 5; ball: 3; ptbiserial: 3; gap: 2; 
# mcclain: 2; gamma: 4; gplus: 4; tau: 2; dunn: 5; hubert: 3; sdindex: 3;
# dindex: 3; sdbw: 5

# nc = 5 occurs 8 times
# nc = 4 occurs 3 times
# nc = 3 occurs 5 times
# nc = 2 occurs 6 times

# ccc: NA; scott: NA; marriot: NA; trcovw: NA; tracew: NA; friedman: NA;
# rubin: NA; frey: NA; 

# NbCluster = 2
# Compute hierarchical clustering on principal components
res.hcpc.1.PB.3 <- HCPC(res.pca.f.1.PB.3,
                      nb.clust = 2,
                      metric = "euclidean", 
                      method = "ward", 
                      graph = FALSE)

f <- fviz_dend(res.hcpc.1.PB.3, 
          cex = 0.7,                     # Label size
          palette = clrs,               # Color palette see ?ggpubr::ggpar
          rect = TRUE, rect_fill = TRUE, # Add rectangle around groups
          rect_border = "jco",           # Rectangle color
          labels_track_height = 0.8,      # Augment the room for labels
          main = "Cluster analysis  - PB Cluster 3"
                    )
print(f)

ggsave(filename = "../figures/PCA_HCPC_PB3.pdf",
       plot = f,
       device = cairo_pdf)

# Bi-space
f <- fviz_cluster(res.hcpc.1.PB.3,
             repel = TRUE,            # Avoid label overlapping
             show.clust.cent = TRUE, # Show cluster centers
             palette = clrs,         # Color palette see ?ggpubr::ggpar
             ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
             main = "Factor map"
             )
print(f)

ggsave(filename = "../figures/PCA_HCPC2D_PB3.pdf",
       plot = f,
       device = cairo_pdf)

#Add the clusters to the original dataset

f.PCAdata.PB.3$IntCluster <- paste('SubCluster',res.hcpc.1.PB.3$data.clust$clust)
write.csv(f.PCAdata.PB.3,'../results/PB_Cluster3.csv')

################################################################################################################################################################################################################

# Extract the PCA values
ind.PCAPB.3 <- get_pca_ind(PCA.f.1.PB.3)
ind.PCAPB.3 <- data.frame(ind.PCAPB.3$coord[,1:4])
ind.PCAPB.3 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(ind.PCAPB.3, "AnimalID")

d <- 4
Psi <- crossprod(matrix(rnorm(d^2), d, d)) # scale

temp <-  tibble::rownames_to_column(f.PCAdata.PB.3, "AnimalID")
data4Niche.PB.3 <- merge(temp, ind.PCAPB.3, by = 'AnimalID')

# Get rid of SubCluster 1 as it only has 3 individuals
#data4Niche.PB.2[which(data4Niche.PB.2$IntCluster == 'SubCluster 1'),] <- NA
data4Niche.PB.3 <- na.omit(data4Niche.PB.3)

#data4Niche.PB <- data4Niche.PB[!data4Niche.PB$cluster == "Cluster 4",] #Get rid of cluster 4
aggregate(data4Niche.PB.3[29:32], data4Niche.PB.3[28], mean)

# Generate parameter draws
nsamples <- 1e4
system.time({
 PB3.par <- tapply(1:nrow(data4Niche.PB.3), data4Niche.PB.3$IntCluster,
                    function(ii) niw.post(nsamples = nsamples, X = data4Niche.PB.3[ii,29:32], Psi = Psi)) # Done with 3 PCs as Subcluster XX only has X individuals
})


 # colors for each cluster

# Plot all mu 
pdf("../figures/PostMu_PB3.pdf")
niche.par.plot(PB3.par, col = clrs, plot.mu = TRUE, plot.Sigma = FALSE)
legend("topleft", legend = names(PB3.par), fill = clrs)
dev.off()

niche.par.plot(PB3.par, col = clrs, plot.mu = TRUE, plot.Sigma = FALSE)
legend("topleft", legend = names(PB3.par), fill = clrs)

# Plot all Sigma 
pdf("../figures/PostSigma_PB3.pdf")
par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
niche.par.plot(PB3.par, col = clrs, plot.mu = FALSE, plot.Sigma = TRUE)
legend("topleft", legend = names(PB3.par), fill = clrs)
dev.off()

niche.par.plot(PB3.par, col = clrs, plot.mu = FALSE, plot.Sigma = TRUE)
legend("topleft", legend = names(PB3.par), fill = clrs)

# 2-d projections of 50 niche regions
nsamples <- 50
PB3.par <- tapply(1:nrow(data4Niche.PB.3), data4Niche.PB.3$IntCluster,
                  function(ii) niw.post(nsamples = nsamples, X = data4Niche.PB.3[ii,29:32], Psi = Psi)) # 6 PCs

# format data for plotting function
PB3.data <- tapply(1:nrow(data4Niche.PB.3), data4Niche.PB.3$IntCluster, function(ii) X = data4Niche.PB.3[ii,29:32])

pdf("../figures/NicheRegionsPB3.pdf")
niche.plot(niche.par = PB3.par, niche.data = PB3.data, pfrac = .05,
          iso.names = c('PCA1','PCA2','PCA3','PCA4'),
            col = clrs, xlab = expression("PCA Scores"))
dev.off()

niche.plot(niche.par = PB3.par, niche.data = PB3.data, pfrac = .05,
          iso.names = c('PCA1','PCA2','PCA3','PCA4'),
            col = clrs, xlab = expression("PCA Scores"))

#########################

# niche overlap plots for 95% niche region sizes
nsamples <- 10000
PB3.par <- tapply(1:nrow(data4Niche.PB.3), data4Niche.PB.3$IntCluster,
                  function(ii) niw.post(nsamples = nsamples, X = data4Niche.PB.3[ii,29:32], Psi = Psi))

# Overlap calculation.  use nsamples = nprob = 10000 (1e4) for higher accuracy.
# the variable over.stat can be supplied directly to the overlap.plot function

over.stat.PB3 <- overlap(PB3.par, nreps = nsamples, nprob = 1e4, alpha = c(0.95, 0.99))

#The mean overlap metrics calculated across iterations for both niche 
#region sizes (alpha = .95 and alpha = .99) can be calculated and displayed in an array.
over.mean.PB3 <- apply(over.stat.PB3, c(1:2,4), mean)*100
round(over.mean.PB3, 2)

# Credibility Intervals
over.cred.PB3 <- apply(over.stat.PB3*100, c(1:2, 4), quantile, prob = c(.025, .975), na.rm = TRUE)
round(over.cred.PB3[,,,1]) # display alpha = .95 niche region

# Overlap plot

over.stat.PB3 <- overlap(PB3.par, nreps = nsamples, nprob = 1e4, alpha = .95)
pdf("../figures/NicheOverlapPB3.pdf")
overlap.plot(over.stat.PB3, col = clrs, mean.cred.col = "turquoise", equal.axis = TRUE,
            xlab = "Overlap Probability (%) -- Niche Region Size: 95%")
dev.off()

overlap.plot(over.stat.PB3, col = clrs, mean.cred.col = "turquoise", equal.axis = TRUE,
            xlab = "Overlap Probability (%) -- Niche Region Size: 95%")

################################################################################
###############################   Niche Size   #################################

# posterior distribution of (mu, Sigma) for each strategy
nsamples <- 10000
PB3.par <- tapply(1:nrow(data4Niche.PB.3), data4Niche.PB.3$IntCluster,
                  function(ii) niw.post(nsamples = nsamples, X = data4Niche.PB.3[ii,29:32], Psi = Psi))

# posterior distribution of niche size by species using the 75% contour to define strategy niche
PB3.size <- sapply(PB3.par, function(spec) {
  apply(spec$Sigma, 3, niche.size, alpha = .75)
})

# point estimate and standard error
rbind(est = colMeans(PB3.size),
      se = apply(PB3.size, 2, sd))

# Niche Size
PB3.size2 <- matrix(NA, nrow = 20000, ncol = 2)
colnames(PB3.size2) <- c("Niche_Size", "SubCluster")
PB3.size2[1:10000,1] <- PB3.size[,1]
PB3.size2[1:10000,2] <- colnames(PB3.size)[1]
PB3.size2[10001:20000,1] <- PB3.size[,2]
PB3.size2[10001:20000,2] <- colnames(PB3.size)[3]
PB3.size2 <- as.data.frame(PB3.size2)
PB3.size2$Niche_Size <- as.numeric(PB3.size2$Niche_Size)

# Bhattacharyya coefficient to see how different the niche sizes are
# Create an empty matrix

Olap.PB3 <- matrix(NA,2,2)
colnames(Olap.PB3) <- c('SubCluster 1',
                        'SubCluster 2')

rownames(Olap.PB3) <- c('SubCluster 1',
                        'SubCluster 2')

for (sc in 1:2){
  for (sc2 in 1:2){
    Olap.PB3[sc,sc2] <-  bhatt.coeff(PB3.size[,sc], PB3.size[,sc2])
  }
  
}



median(PB3.size[,1])
range(PB3.size[,1])

median(PB3.size[,2])
range(PB3.size[,2])


plt.niche <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = PB3.size2,
  x = SubCluster,
  y = Niche_Size,
  type = "rb",
  box.args = list(width = 0),
  point.args = list(alpha = 0),
  xlab = "SubClusters PB3",
  ylab = "Niche Size"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = clrs)

print(plt.niche)

ggsave(filename = "../figures/NicheStrategies_PB3.pdf",
       plot = plt.niche,
       device = cairo_pdf)




# Summary table
sum.PB3 <- summary_table(f.PCAdata.PB.3, our_summary1)
sum.PB3
```
